e-Sevai - Configure e-Sevai ☰ Home About Login Contact Anytime Anywhere Citizen Services » Description Under the initiative of Government of Tamil Nadu - Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency (TNeGA), as a State Nodal Agency has been formed to support and drive all e-Governance activities. TNeGA is implementing various e-Governance projects with the objective of making all Government services, wherever feasible & accessible to the common man in an efficient and transparent manner. To start with TNeGA has deployed two Revenue Services (Community Certificate and Nativity Certificate) to public on a pilot run and to deploy other services simultaneously. Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency aims to fulfill the Vision, "Through use of Information Technology in Governance and delivery of services to public at their doorsteps. The Policy is to achieve the vision of integrated service delivery to the Citizen any time anywhere. » Who can apply This service is intended for applicants of all ages. » How to Access the Service Register yourself as an applicant (if not already registered). Log-on to the site by entering the User Name, Password and Captcha code given Once logged in, on the left menu click on Apply for services and then click on View services. Click on ' Apply '. » Pricing Price is Rs. 60 /- per application for community and nativity respectively. » Service Specific Terms and Conditions List of documents required for application Applicants Photo, Any Address proof, Self-declaration, List of optional documents for Community Certificate Community Certificate of Father / Mother / Siblings, List of optional documents for Nativity Certificate Birth Certificate, School Education Certificate (or) Employment Details (or) Other Proof to prove continuous residence of 5years » Contact Details TamilNadu e - Governance Agency No.9,
